---
title: "Region x Time"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

Religious groups in Southwest Asia, Europe, Africa and East Asia, without eHRAF and Pulotu, start
year from 3000 BCE to 1500 CE (`-3000 <= year_from < 1500`), any time span. Conflicting answers (both "Yes" and
"No" for the same question and entry) are left out.

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py`. Fits are saved in `fits/` (`region_time_<model>_*`; delete
them to refit), figures in `fig/region_time/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(loo)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/region_time/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/region_time"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

regions <- c("Southwest Asia", "Europe", "Africa", "East Asia")
region_colors <- c("Southwest Asia" = "#2a78d6", "Europe" = "#eb6834", "Africa" = "#1baf7a", "East Asia" = "#eda100",
                   "average" = "#52514e")
pooled_labels <- c(average = "average of region slopes", common = "common slope", no_region = "no region")
pooled_colors <- c("average of region slopes" = "#1a1a1a", "common slope" = "#8a63d2", "no region" = "#a3a29b")
year_min <- -3000
year_max <- 1500
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
source_of <- read_csv("../data/sccsrv3/entry_data.csv", col_select = c(entry_id, data_source)) |>
  distinct(entry_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

d_window <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  left_join(source_of, by = "entry_id") |>
  filter(
    poll == "group",
    world_region %in% regions,
    is.na(data_source) | (data_source != "eHRAF" & !str_starts(data_source, "Pulotu")),
    year_from >= year_min, year_from < year_max
  ) |>
  mutate(region = factor(world_region, levels = regions), time = year_from / 1000)

# conflicting answers (Yes and No for the same entry and question; weight < 1) are left out
conflicting <- d_window |> filter(weight < 1) |> distinct(entry_id, entry_name, region, question_short)
d <- d_window |> filter(weight == 1)

# parent question of each family of child questions
parent_of <- c(monitoring = "supernatural monitoring present", shg = "supreme high god present")

# child questions in topic order (as in 4_baseline.Rmd)
topic_order <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
all_questions <- c(unname(parent_of), topic_order)

questions <- d |>
  distinct(family, question_short) |>
  filter(question_short %in% all_questions)
stopifnot(setequal(topic_order, filter(questions, family != "parent")$question_short))

# samples (one model per question in each)
sets <- list(
  parent = d |> filter(question_short %in% parent_of), # incl. inferred "No" for the supreme high god
  conditional = d |> filter(question_short %in% topic_order, !inferred)  # child questions as answered
)
runs <- bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "parent", question = unname(parent_of)),
  tibble(set = "conditional", question = topic_order)
)
```

Groups per region in the window (any question):

```{r data_regions}
d_window |> distinct(entry_id, region) |> count(region, name = "in_window")
```

Left out (conflicting answers, entry and question):

```{r data_conflicting}
conflicting
```

Entries per question and region (parent questions and child questions as answered):

```{r data_questions}
bind_rows(sets) |>
  group_by(question = question_short, region) |>
  summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(match(question, all_questions)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Models and priors

```{r model}
models <- list(
  region_time = bf(answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time),
  common = bf(answer_value ~ 0 + region + time),
  no_region = bf(answer_value ~ 0 + Intercept + time)
)

# brms names the region coefficients without spaces (regionSouthwestAsia, regionSouthwestAsia:time, ...)
region_key <- setNames(regions, str_remove_all(regions, " "))
region_priors <- reduce(
  map(paste0("region", names(region_key)), ~ set_prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", coef = .x)),
  c,
  .init = prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
)
priors <- list(
  region_time = region_priors,
  common = region_priors,
  no_region = c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"), prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"))
)
```

`0 + Intercept` is the brms way of not centering the predictors, so the intercept prior of the no-region model
is at 0 CE, as for the region intercepts.

# Fit

Each model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each question with `update()`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
templates <- imap(models, function(formula, model) {
  suppressWarnings(brm(formula, data = sets$parent, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors[[model]],
                       chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))
})

fit_question <- function(model, set, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/region_time_%s_%s_%s.rds", model, set, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    templates[[model]],
    newdata = filter(sets[[set]], question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, seed = 125123, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

fits <- crossing(model = names(models), runs) |>
  mutate(fit = pmap(list(model, set, question), fit_question))
fits_rt <- filter(fits, model == "region_time")
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(diag)

# worst values per model and set
diagnostics |>
  group_by(model, set) |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(max_rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail),
            divergences = sum(divergences), .groups = "drop")

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Estimates

```{r estimates}
summarise_slope <- function(value) {
  tibble(mean = mean(value), lower = quantile(value, 0.025), upper = quantile(value, 0.975), p_positive = mean(value > 0))
}

# region x time model: region slopes per draw, plus their average
region_slopes <- function(fit) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_region.*:time$", regex = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(.draw, starts_with("b_")) |>
    pivot_longer(-.draw, values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(region = unname(region_key[str_remove(str_remove(name, "^b_region"), ":time$")])) |>
    select(.draw, region, value)
  average <- draws |> group_by(.draw) |> summarise(value = mean(value)) |> mutate(region = "average")
  bind_rows(draws, average)
}

add_panels <- function(est) {
  est |>
    left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
    mutate(
      panel = case_when(set == "parent" ~ "parent", family == "monitoring" ~ "monitoring", TRUE ~ "supreme\nhigh god"),
      panel = factor(panel, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "supreme\nhigh god")),
      question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions))
    )
}

# (b) slopes per region (and their average)
estimates <- fits_rt |>
  mutate(est = map(fit, function(fit) {
    region_slopes(fit) |> group_by(region) |> reframe(summarise_slope(value))
  })) |>
  select(set, question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  add_panels() |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c(regions, "average")))

# (a) pooled slopes: average of the region slopes, common slope, no region
pooled <- fits |>
  mutate(est = map2(fit, model, function(fit, model) {
    value <- if (model == "region_time") {
      filter(region_slopes(fit), region == "average")$value
    } else {
      as_draws_df(fit, variable = "b_time")$b_time
    }
    summarise_slope(value)
  })) |>
  select(model, set, question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  mutate(estimate = factor(pooled_labels[if_else(model == "region_time", "average", model)], levels = pooled_labels)) |>
  add_panels()
```

## Pooled slopes (a)

Pooled change in log-odds per 1,000 years (mean and 95% interval): average of the four region slopes (main
estimate), common slope (region intercepts, one shared slope), and no region (one slope, regions ignored).

```{r pooled, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 12}
p_pooled <- ggplot(pooled, aes(mean, question, colour = estimate, group = fct_rev(estimate))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pooled_colors) +
  labs(x = "Pooled time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
save_plot(p_pooled, "slopes_pooled", 8, 12)
```

## Slopes per region (b)

Change in log-odds per 1,000 years within each region (mean and 95% interval), and the average of the four
region slopes (grey). Panels: parent questions, monitoring children and supreme high god children (as answered).
The three pooled estimates are compared in "Pooled slopes (a)" above.

```{r slopes, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 13}
p_slopes <- ggplot(estimates, aes(mean, question, colour = region, group = fct_rev(region))) +  # top to bottom in legend order
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = region_colors, breaks = c(regions, "average")) +
  labs(x = "Time slope within region (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
save_plot(p_slopes, "slopes", 9, 13)
```

## Do the regions need their own slopes?

Leave-one-out comparison (expected log predictive density, elpd) of the common-slope and no-region models
against the region x time model, per question. Negative: worse than region x time; a difference of less than
about 2 standard errors is not a clear difference.

Regions differ clearly in level for about a third of the questions, and somewhat for many more. Regions rarely differ in slope.

```{r loo, warning = FALSE}
# elpd of model a minus elpd of the region x time model b, as "diff (se)"
elpd_vs <- function(a, b) {
  x <- loo_compare(list(a = a, b = b))
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", if (rownames(x)[1] == "a") -x[2, "elpd_diff"] else x[2, "elpd_diff"], x[2, "se_diff"])
}

# one core: forking for each of the 114 small fits can exhaust processes ("unable to fork"), and gains nothing
fits |>
  mutate(loo = map(fit, ~ loo(.x, cores = 1))) |>
  select(model, set, question, loo) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = loo) |>
  transmute(
    question = factor(question, levels = all_questions),
    common_vs_region_time = map2_chr(common, region_time, elpd_vs),
    no_region_vs_region_time = map2_chr(no_region, region_time, elpd_vs)
  ) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Curves over time

One panel per question (parent question first), all four regions together.

- **Overall** (black line, grey band: 95% interval): the "typical region", logit⁻¹(ᾱ + β̄·time) with ᾱ and β̄ the
  averages of the four region intercepts and slopes (per draw); its slope is the pooled slope reported above.
- **Regions** (coloured lines): posterior mean of the region x time model, drawn over the region's data range for
  that question (first to last start year); dashed where the 500-year rolling window has fewer than 10 entries.
- **Data** (points): share yes per region in 500-year bins of start year (3000-2500 BCE, ..., 1000-1500 CE; lower
  edge included), size = number of entries; the four regions are shifted slightly around the bin midpoint so they
  do not overlap. Black-outlined points at the midpoint: all four regions pooled (share of all entries in the bin,
  so regions with more entries count more, unlike the overall curve).

```{r curves}
years <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 50)
answers <- bind_rows(sets, .id = "set") |> select(set, question = question_short, region, entry_id, year_from, answer_value)

# overall curve: average region intercept and slope per draw
overall_curves <- fits_rt |>
  mutate(curve = map(fit, function(fit) {
    draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_region", regex = TRUE) |> as_tibble()
    a <- rowMeans(select(draws, starts_with("b_region") & !ends_with(":time")))
    b <- rowMeans(select(draws, starts_with("b_region") & ends_with(":time")))
    p <- plogis(outer(a, rep(1, length(years))) + outer(b, years / 1000))
    tibble(year = years, mean = colMeans(p), lo95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.025), hi95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.975))
  })) |>
  select(set, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve)

# entries per region in 500-year rolling windows of start year (centred every 50 years)
rolling <- map_dfr(years, function(centre) {
  answers |>
    filter(year_from >= centre - 250, year_from < centre + 250) |>
    group_by(set, question, region) |>
    summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(year = centre)
})

# region curves (posterior mean) within each region's data range, solid where the rolling window has at least 10 entries
grid <- crossing(region = factor(regions, levels = regions), year = years) |> mutate(time = year / 1000)
data_range <- answers |>
  group_by(set, question, region) |>
  summarise(from = floor(min(year_from) / 50) * 50, to = ceiling(max(year_from) / 50) * 50, .groups = "drop")
region_lines <- fits_rt |>
  mutate(curve = map(fit, ~ mutate(grid, mean = colMeans(posterior_epred(.x, newdata = grid))))) |>
  select(set, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve) |>
  inner_join(data_range, by = c("set", "question", "region")) |>
  filter(year >= from, year <= to) |>
  left_join(rolling, by = c("set", "question", "region", "year")) |>
  mutate(solid = if_else(replace_na(n, 0) >= 10, mean, NA_real_))

# observed share per region in 500-year bins of start year
bin_edges <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 500)
offsets <- setNames(c(-75, -25, 25, 75), regions)
binned <- answers |>
  mutate(bin = findInterval(year_from, bin_edges)) |>
  group_by(set, question, region, bin) |>
  summarise(share = mean(answer_value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = bin_edges[bin] + 250 + offsets[as.character(region)])
binned_pooled <- answers |>
  mutate(bin = findInterval(year_from, bin_edges)) |>
  group_by(set, question, bin) |>
  summarise(share = mean(answer_value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = bin_edges[bin] + 250)

together_colors <- c(region_colors[regions], overall = "black")
together_plot <- function(questions_, ncol = 6) {
  keep <- function(x) filter(x, question %in% questions_) |> mutate(question = factor(question, levels = questions_))
  lines <- keep(region_lines)
  overall <- keep(overall_curves)
  ggplot(mapping = aes(year)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(data = overall, aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = keep(binned), aes(y = share, colour = region, size = n), alpha = 0.65) +
    geom_line(data = lines, aes(y = mean, colour = region, group = region), linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "22") +
    geom_line(data = lines, aes(y = solid, colour = region, group = region), linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_line(data = overall, aes(y = mean, colour = "overall"), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = keep(binned_pooled), aes(y = share, size = n), shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", stroke = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ question, ncol = ncol) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = together_colors, breaks = names(together_colors), labels = c(regions, "overall (typical region)")) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 4.5, breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 40)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(year_min, year_max, by = 1000)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), xlim = c(year_min, year_max)) +
    labs(x = "Year (start year)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL, size = "entries") +
    theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
}

monitoring_questions <- c(parent_of[["monitoring"]], intersect(topic_order, filter(questions, family == "monitoring")$question_short))
shg_questions <- c(parent_of[["shg"]], intersect(topic_order, filter(questions, family == "shg")$question_short))
```

## Supernatural monitoring

```{r curves_together_monitoring, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 12}
save_plot(together_plot(monitoring_questions), "curves_together_monitoring", 16, 12)
```
